metadata.title: Cybersecurity Control Catalog - Backup and Recovery

props.name: keywords
props.value: IM8, GovTech, Singapore, cybersecurity, Backup and Recovery

props.name: risk-statement
props.value: Without regular backups stored in a secure and separate location, there is an increased risk of data loss, system failures, and extended downtime in the event of accidental deletion, hardware failures, or malicious attacks.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Backup all important data and systems at least every {{ insert: param, br-1_prm_1 }} day(s), and store backups in a secure and separate location.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Use default CSP-managed backup services (e.g., AWS Backup, Azure Backup, GCP Backup and DR Service). Consider alternative backup services only when default CSP services cannot be used. Store backups and snapshots separately to primary data storage with data encrypted-at-rest. For SaaS, ensure that SaaS provider is able to restore last backup.

guidelines.prose: The time period in days for backup.

props.name: risk-statement
props.value: Failure to regularly test recovery processes may result in ineffective response during actual incidents, increasing the risk of prolonged downtime, data loss, and compromised business continuity in the event of a disaster or system failure.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Conduct testing of recovery processes at least every {{ insert: param, br-2_prm_1 }} day(s) to ensure their effectiveness.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Ensure each test verifies the system's ability to fully restore all data and services.

guidelines.prose: The time period in days for recovery testing.

props.name: risk-statement
props.value: Lack of prevention measures against the modification or deletion of backups for the specified duration increases the risk of data loss, unauthorised alterations, and potential inability to recover from incidents, compromising the integrity and availability of critical information.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Prevent backups from being modified or deleted for {{ insert: param, br-3_prm_1 }} day(s) or as stipulated in the agency's data retention policies.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Use S3 Object Lock or Azure Blob Storage with immutability enabled to enforce time-based retention policies.

guidelines.prose: The time period in days of backup retention.

props.name: risk-statement
props.value: Absence of a comprehensive disaster recovery plan increases the risk of prolonged system downtime, data loss, and inability to maintain business continuity in the event of a disaster, potentially leading to significant financial losses and damage to organisational reputation.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Develop, maintain, and regularly test a disaster recovery plan that ensures critical functions and data can be restored within the Recovery Time Objective (RTO) and Recovery Point Objective (RPO) as determined by business requirements and risk assessments.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: The disaster recovery plan should include clearly defined roles and responsibilities, step-by-step recovery procedures, communication protocols during a disaster, and integration with the overall business continuity plan. Assess the effectiveness of the existing disaster recovery plan during disaster recovery exercises.

props.name: risk-statement
props.value: Failure to develop a Business Continuity Plan may result in prolonged system downtime, loss of critical data, and diminished organisational resilience during disruptive events, increasing the risk of financial and reputational damage.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Refer to the Cyber Security Agency's Cybersecurity Toolkit for IT Teams for a business continuity plan template.

props.name: risk-statement
props.value: Failure to conduct regular business continuity exercises may lead to unpreparedness during an actual disruption, increasing response times, operational impact, and the risk of ineffective recovery, ultimately jeopardising business operations and stakeholder trust.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Conduct a business continuity exercise at least every {{ insert: param, br-6_prm_1 }} day(s) to test the effectiveness of the business continuity plan.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Conduct testing based on the business continuity plan which can include checklists, tabletop exercises, and simulations.

guidelines.prose: The time period in days of business continuity exercise frequency.
